title: REQ · validateWorld scene character tests assert exact path-tagged errors
summary: validateWorld tests fail when the scene character check is missing.
description: Context: game/src/content/loader.ts L142-L146 reports 'scenes[<id>].characters[<i>].id: unknown character <id>'. Desired behavior: tests assert the exact message, the index and absence of errors when characters are undefined or valid. Expected result: removing the check fails a test. Why: dangling character references must be caught at load time.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scene with an unknown character at index 1, when validateWorld runs, then the errors contain 'scenes[bedroom].characters[1].id: unknown character ghost'
Given a scene with no characters field, when validateWorld runs, then no character error is reported
Given one unknown scene character, when validateWorld runs, then exactly one error is reported
technical_constraints: Tests build LoadedWorld objects in memory
definition_of_done: Check covered by tests that fail without it
